title: The breathing hole on the object

tellings.quote: >> yeah, dusty. And then you see like it's from this hole this milk is going Uh-huh.

plain: In 2012 a diver exploring a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea is said to have seen a hole in it with a milky substance pouring out, which would hint that the thing is more than ordinary rock. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, whose team found the object, tells it on the diver's behalf, repeating what his fellow diver Stefan Hogeborn told him about the dusty surface and the milk-like stream coming "from this hole."
